facts.fact: The ministry's director of cloud infrastructure, Salma Tazi, said the ministry has put in place the Cloud Strategy 2025-2030 roadmap, whose Cloud First Policy makes cloud the default for all public administrations and is backed by a circular of the head of government.

MAR.note: No data centre in service is named.

facts.fact: LesEco reports Morocco's Cloud Strategy 2025-2030 and Cloud First Policy, a circular-backed default for public administrations within Digital Morocco 2030, are presented as pillars of digital sovereignty.

MAR.note: A planned cloud centre of excellence is to write technical references; no standards are stated as drafted or published.
No nationally owned data centre in service is named.
